description:
Several tests attach telemetry handlers with inline/anonymous function captures, which causes `:telemetry` itself to emit an [info] log warning on every attach:

  [info] The function passed as a handler with ID "await-tool-start-6597" is a local function.
  This means that it is either an anonymous function or a capture of a function without a module specified...

This noise was previously drowned out by the telemetry→Logger bridge (now gated off by default via `config :octo_pi_ai, OctoPi.Telemetry.Logger, enabled: true`). With the bridge silent, these warnings dominate test output.

Fix: give the affected test helpers a module-level `handle_event/4` and attach with `&Module.handle_event/4` instead of closures like `&send(self(), {:telemetry, ...})`.

Known hotspots (loop_test.exs surfaces them most):
  apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/loop_test.exs
  apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/subscribers_test.exs
Sweep the rest of `apps/*/test/` for other inline captures while we're here.

Deferred as cleanup behind octo-3di (Phase 4 TUI) so tests stay stable during that epic.
title: Tests: replace local-function telemetry handlers with module captures
